Host
[host.rs]
Starts the supervisor and the IPC server; restarts the service when its own program changed and nothing runs.

Windows SCM entry and install; macOS launch agent; Linux systemd user unit; session FFI.

[ipc.rs]
Named pipe with ACL (Windows) or 0600 Unix socket; hello first; frames bounded; at most 32 connections; push stream after Subscribe.

div.div:
Supervisor
[supervisor.rs]
One thread, one channel of Msg: requests, runner output lines, worker results, log-on changes, and a tick every second. Per runner it owns a Controller, a JobTracker, an UpdateMachine, the log file and tail, and housekeeping state. No locks: one runner's failure is only a state of that runner.

pitcrew-core
[Rust library]

Spawns with piped output, stops gracefully (SIGTERM, Ctrl+Break), kills the tree only after the timeout; every external program has a timeout.
